1.d4 d5 2.c4 e6 3.Nc3 Nf6 4.Bg5 Be7 5.e3.strategy: Keeps the pin and the tension rather than trading: the bishop stays on the diagonal against f6, so Black must still find a way to deal with it. White avoids giving up the bishop for a knight and leaves Black to untangle.

Castles into safety and lets White decide what the bishop is for. Black keeps the solid structure and aims to ease the cramp by exchanging pieces, since the c8-bishop is still shut in and every trade gives it more room.
